privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seo_desc: How I handle your personal data, in compliance with the LGPD.
privacy.intro: Transparency is the basis of how I work. This Privacy Policy details how I handle your personal data, in compliance with the LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law) and with app store guidelines (Google Play Store and Apple App Store).
privacy.sec1_content: I collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone) and automatic technical data (IP address, device type, advertising identifiers). This data is essential to operate the applications safely and efficiently.
privacy.sec2_content: Your data is used for: (a) providing services and technical support; (b) marketing communications, only with your consent; (c) system security and fraud prevention; (d) compliance with legal obligations.
privacy.sec3_content: I do not sell your data. I may share information with trusted partners (for example, cloud providers and analytics tools such as Google Analytics) only to make the app work, under confidentiality agreements.
privacy.sec4_content: I keep your data only as long as necessary. You have the right to request full deletion of your information at any time through the contact channels.
privacy.sec5_content: You have the right to access, rectify, object to and port your data. You keep control over your digital identity inside the applications.
privacy.sec6_content: The applications may integrate third-party APIs (Maps, Firebase, Ads). I recommend reading the privacy policies of those specific providers for a complete picture.
privacy.sec7_content: Your right to be forgotten is guaranteed. You can request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data at any time.
privacy.contact_info: To exercise your rights or ask a question, reach me at juan{'@'}loboczss.cloud.
